summary: The hook blocks a left or right border on a sticky column when the border stops short of the page.
doc: This hook denies a write when one CSS rule has position: sticky, a top offset and a left or right border, or when a Tailwind className has sticky, a top-* utility and border-l or border-r. A sticky rail has only its own content height, so its divider stops while the middle column continues. Paint the line on the grid container at full height, or keep the border on a stretching column and make an inner wrapper sticky. Sticky table cells, including th or td, are exempt because they match the height of their row.
